labelAssociation.note: Labels are properly associated, so getByLabel works — the only corpus app where it does. Where a control has no label, data-testid is present and is the better handle anyway.

naming.pattern: PascalCase.tsx, co-located with the route under app/**/ or shared in packages/ui

hazards.impact: no public instance of the authenticated app exists, so 76 of 78 screens can only be crawled against a self-hosted deployment.
these render inside an iframe and are not standalone screens.

notes: This app needs the least from the label machinery and the most from the route union: it is the case where 'a declared route the crawl never reached is still a page object' does the real work.
